title: Login Page with Authentication Gate
description: Add a glassmorphism login page that gates the entire app behind authentication, with server-side login validation and rate limiting.
steps: Update src/App.tsx to gate behind login
Update src/components/Header.tsx to show user info and logout
Add POST /api/auth/login endpoint with stricter rate limiting in server.ts
acceptance_criteria: Login page shows before any app content
Valid credentials authenticate user and show main app
Logout clears session and returns to login
Rate limiting on login endpoint (5 per minute per IP)
